lines.en: label halloweenayane1:
scene ayanefreakin1
: What do you mean you have no idea what’s going on right now?!
: Everything was fine and normal a second ago and...and we were at my house! And then there was this girl who showed up and dragged Sensei away and now we’re here! You remember, right?!?! RIGHT?!?!?!
: Uhh, Ayane? You maybe want to, like...take a chill-pill for a second? Because I’m not really sure what’s going on, but yelling about it in front of everyone isn’t going to-
: Sensei! You remember, don’t you?! You came with me, right?! You’re still the you I know, aren’t you?! The one I’m supposed to be with forever?! Please tell me you’re still here! Please!
: Ayane, you’re scaring me. Please calm down.
scene ayanefreakin2
: Calm down?! You want me to calm down?! After being sent back this far?! After everything that happened?! How the fuck am I supposed to calm down, Ami?! How?!
: Ayane...if you need to go outside and talk, we can. But let the record show that I have no clue what you’re talking about and that I also think you should stop yelling.
scene ayanefreakin3
: Did you have a bad dream or something maybe?
: ...bad dream?
: Well...yeah.
: You said all that weird stuff about being “sent back,” but you’ve been right here with us the whole day.
: You said she’d been practicin’ her set a lot, didn’t you? Think maybe she’s just overworked herself or something like that?
: I wouldn’t be surprised. She’s been trying so hard to make sure her stand-up thing will be perfect lately that I could probably go up there and perform it.
: You might have to at this rate. The second floor is still winning and we were really relying on Ayane to come through here.
scene ayanefreakin4
: Heh...
: Ayane...why not just take a seat and-
scene ayanefreakin5
: HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!! SO THIS IS HOW IT WORKS!??!!??!! OH MY GOD!!! THAT’S EVEN MORE CRUEL THAN I THOUGHT!!!! HAHAHAHAHA!
: I...think I’m gonna go see if the cafe lady can make her some tea or something. Chamomile’s supposed to help with nerves, right?
scene ayanefreakin6

: Yes! Chamomile! Bring me all the fucking chamomile in the world! Because I’m sure fucking going to need it if I’m going to have to sit through both of these two breaking into a million fucking pieces again!
scene ayanefreakin7
: On it. Nothing to see here, girls! Everybody mind your own business until Ayane calms down, please! Thanks!
: You still love me at least, right?
: Ayane, what in the world are you talking about?
: Things I can’t say in front of everyone else. Things that we do when we’re alone. You still love me, right?
: Because you look different. You smell different. But I know it’s you. It’s you, right? Where were we just a minute ago? What was I wearing? Where did that girl take you?
scene ayanefreakin8
: Please don’t make me start all over...
: Please be you.
: Molly, move.
: Wha- Bronya!? We’re supposed to be in love! You can’t just push past me like-
scene ayanefreakin9
: Ayane...shut the fuck up.
scene ayanefreakin10
: You. Me. Outside. Now.
: Are you...
: Who I think you are?...
: That’s a great question. Especially since you’re decidedly not who I thought you were just a second ago. But that doesn’t change the fact that you’re saying too much.
: I’m sorry! I’m just...really scared and...confused and...everything’s suddenly different, but...it’s the same and-
: Yeah. It’s very, very sad. But I’m going to need you to grow the fuck up for a second and talk to me outside because it’s dangerous for you to keep throwing your little temper tantrum in here.
: Temper...tantrum?
: Outside. Now.
scene ayanefreakin11
: What the hell was that about?
: I have no idea. I’ve never seen Ayane get that...crazy before.
: You don’t think what Miss Imai said was true about the whole...overworking thing, do you? Because Ayane always works hard. Just...this...
: Yeah...I hope everything’s okay. Are you sure you don’t want to go out there with them, though?
: Not really. Maya scares me when she gets all serious like that.
scene ayanefreakin12
: Besides, I doubt I’d have any idea what the two of them are talking about anyway...
: Okay, so...To start, mind explaining to me what the fuck is going on here?
: Is it...really you, Maya?...
: What kind of question is that? Who else would I be?
: Well...still you, but...like...a different version? One that’s...way more upfront about her feelings for Sensei and-
scene ayanefreakin13
: H...How do you even know about that?! I’ve barely said a word to or about him in years! And especially not to you!
: But in my world you did!
scene ayanefreakin14
: In my world, you two...
: Well, it pains me to admit it, but you two were in love. You were still a bitch about it, of course. But I knew how you felt and you knew that I knew that.
: I doubt what you witnessed was “love.” I was probably just going through another lustful rage. That happens sometimes. But...wait, how the fuck are you involved now? Do you know about the resets?
scene ayanefreakin15
: Yeah...Do you think that’s what’s...happening right now?
: Also, can I hug you? Because it’s been a long time since I’ve seen the real you and...I miss you a lot.
: Maybe later. I’m just...I need a minute to try and wrap my head around everything right now.
: You and me both. One second, I’m at one party. The next, I’m at a party several years before that and no one remembers where we were just a second ago. Unless you-
: No...I’ve been here the whole time. My last reset was months ago. But nobody else is supposed to know about them here.
: Not even Sensei?
: Definitely not Sensei. He’s too busy fucking Ami to figure any of that stuff out. And I doubt he’ll-
scene ayanefreakin16
: Wait...
: Was that you...implying he actually figures it out in your timeline? Or...is that just wishful thinking on my end?
: Where or...when I come from, he knows. Makoto too. And then...Yumi sometimes and...Tsuneyo sometimes and...I thought Sana did, but...
scene ayanefreakin17
: And you said I...loved him?
: Yeah...and I can promise you it wasn’t just a “lustful rampage” like you suggested.
scene ayanefreakin18
: Is it nice there?...
: As nice as it...can be when you’re caught in a timeloop, I guess.
: So...he and I are...
: We’re together there?...
: Why are you hesitating? What happened? What did he do? What did I do? Why aren’t your eyes filled with joy and envy describing this to me?
: Maya, I don’t know how you’re going to react to this, so I’m just going to come out and say it...
: You get sent back during a reset. And the you who takes your place is just as oblivious to all of this as everyone here.
scene ayanefreakin19
: Wait, I get sent back?! How?! That’s not how it’s supposed to work! What the fuck happened?!
: I, uhh...
: I’m pretty sure you guys had sex on the roof.
scene ayanefreakin20
: You’re joking, right?
: I mean...I didn’t see what happened...just the...the aftermath...
scene ayanefreakin21
: FUCKING HELL! SERIOUSLY, ME?!
scene ayanefreakin22
: Am I that bad at controlling myself even a gajillion years into the future where I’d risk everything to just fuck him one more time?! Does this lust know no bounds?!
: Uhh...I...I don’t know?
: Do you have any idea how many Senseis I’ve broken, Ayane? Because it’s a fucking lot! So if I’m actually the one who broke this time, I probably deserve it! But still!
scene ayanefreakin23
: Aren’t there...more pressing matters to talk about than your sexual relationship with Sensei?
: Yeah, we’ll get to those. For now, I want to hear more about what happened in your world. Because I can’t even remember the last time there was any sort of new development here.
: What happened to him when I vanished? Did he blame himself? He probably did, didn’t he?
: He kind of, just...shut himself off from everyone but Ami for a few months. He still hasn’t fully recovered really. It’s been...probably a year since then.

: Ugh! I can’t believe I fucking did that! Guess it just goes to show no matter how many times I tell myself I’ll be able to keep my distance when he comes back, I’ll still fucking crumble in the end!
: But this is huge, Ayane. This means it’s possible. This means there’s a method to all of this madness and that through enough trial and error, things can actually start to work!
: Of course, it will probably be millions of years until it actually does considering my luck, but still! I can find him!
: What? Why do you look so sad?
: Because I don’t want to wait millions of years...I want him now.
scene ayanefreakin24
: Yeah, well get in line. You’ve been without him for like ten minutes while I’ve legitimately lost track of the last time there was even someone I could delude myself into believing is him here.

: That doesn’t make it any less scary for me, Maya! And also, I don’t understand what that means! Aren’t they all Sensei? Just at...different points in time or something? Like, isn’t that what being “reset” means?
: Maybe for you and me and everyone else with a vagina. He’s the exception to that. All this one does is fuck Ami and watch football.
scene ayanefreakin25
: What?
: I mean, they all fuck Ami. The football thing is, like...seriously annoying though. I have no idea how this one made it so far. Just bring on the next one already.
: Maya...I really miss you.
scene ayanefreakin26
: I mean...I wish I could say the same, but...you’re just Ayane to me.
: Do we have a...better relationship where you’re from? Do I become less mean once I finally find what I’m looking for? Also, Yumi? Really? How does she become involved?
: I’m not really sure which of those questions to answer first, so I’ll just say that our relationship is still mostly one-sided. I doubt you...cared much about me there either.
: But I’d have never learned about this world if it wasn’t for you, so...I owe you a lot of thanks. And I never got to really say that before you disappeared.
: Don’t thank me for unintentionally dragging you into an eternity worth of misery and regretful encounters with people who resemble the man you love. If I really did that, I ruined your life.
: It’s not like you went out of your way to get me involved. It was kind of the opposite, actually. Like you never wanted me to be involved to begin with.
: Well, yeah. Why would I want to drag anyone else into this mess? It sucks. The best case scenario is you being repeatedly sent back every few semesters so you don’t have to deal with it.

: Like sure, you might have to deal with Sensei fucking Ami and binging football for a few months sometimes. But eventually, there’s going to be one who likes blondes and you’ll get to be happy again for a little while.
: That’s not true happiness, though.
scene ayanefreakin27
: But you’ll feel like it is because you’ll be none the wiser to what’s actually going on behind the scenes. Trust me, I’m right.
: Well, even if you are...I don’t regret learning. I don’t regret falling even harder for him than I already had before all of this started.
: Sorry, should I take this as an admission that you’re also fucking my boyfriend in the future where he and I get back together?
scene ayanefreakin28
: He’s fucking everyone, isn’t he?
: You said it, not me.
scene ayanefreakin29
: This rage will fuel me for millennia.
: O-On the bright side! He’d definitely pick you over everyone else if he really had to!
scene ayanefreakin30

: Well, duh. That’s how being star-crossed lovers works. I just never realized other stars would start getting dragged into our tragic love story and turn this into some sort of everlasting meteor shower.
: So do you, like...want to try and figure out how to go back together then?
scene ayanefreakin31
: Ayane...

: We can, right? Like...this is probably just another one of those weird...reset puzzle things! And we just have to solve it and we’ll go right back to the hyper-depressive harem comedy where we belong!
scene ayanefreakin32
: D-Don’t look at me like that! This is only temporary! I’m...I’m here for a reason! I have to be! So I’ll just...stay positive and-
: Just stop, okay?
scene ayanefreakin33
: Getting your hopes up is...the worst thing you can do here.
: Just take solace in the fact that you have someone who won’t look at you like you’re insane whenever you talk about the world ending.
: Plus, I doubt the “me” who took my place would be happy to be swapped out for a more jaded, narcissistic version.
: But she’ll become that way on her own...won’t she? Just like you did.
: Then let her.
: Maya...you don’t mean that.
scene ayanefreakin34

: Oh, I know. I would gladly screw myself over if it meant getting out of this loop. I just felt like I was supposed to say something like that there or it might negatively affect my future in some way.
: Oh.
: We’re still fucked, though. I have no idea when the next reset is coming. And if that was the catalyst that sent you here, I imagine it’ll have to be another that takes you back.
: So am I just...supposed to wait here until that happens? Isn’t there something we can do?...
scene ayanefreakin35
: I don’t know. Do you like football?
